name: Walton Boat Hire
summary: Walton Boat Hire advertises a small fleet of six-seat self-drive motor day boats from Walton Marina. The operator states that no licence is required, with instructions, a safety briefing and lifejackets provided before departure. Dogs are welcome.
reasonToVisit: Self-drive day boats from Walton Marina, no licence required
planningDetail: Usually Easter to October. Booking is by enquiry — confirm boats are running before building a visit around it
bookingNote: Booking is handled by enquiry with the operator
